basic_info.description: Here is Arturo! I'm a Software developer and Data analyst, this page exists now to show my portfolio! If you see something interesting, let's chat!

chat.welcome: Hi! I'm Arturo's assistant. How can I help you today? 👋

faq.question: What services do you offer?
faq.answer: My services include: routine process automation with optional AI integration, training in AI usage and automation, and AI agent development.

faq.question: How much does it cost?
faq.answer: Pricing depends on the scope and complexity of each project. Contact me and we'll find the best solution for your budget!

faq.question: How can I contact you?
faq.answer: You can reach me via Email or WhatsApp. Check the links in the footer!

faq.question: What technologies do you work with?
faq.answer: I work with Python, JavaScript, SQLite, Databricks, n8n, MAKE, OpenClaw/NemoClaw (local AI agents in isolated sandbox via OpenShell), and AI agent development with other LLMs.

projects.title: infinity gautlet
projects.description: Full-stack web application built with the MERN stack. Features include user authentication (login, sign up, and Google OAuth), Slack channel integration via event-based registration, and a Kanban-style to-do list with full CRUD operations and status tracking (Pending → In Progress → Done). Built with a RESTful API architecture covering both frontend and backend.

projects.title: Data Autoupdate
projects.description: Automated fraud prevention analytics system built with Power Automate and Power BI. Processed sales data to detect anomalies and generate daily and monthly reports on total losses and losses prevented, delivered to directors and the finance department. — Demo and repository coming soon.

projects.title: Real time Fraud Alert
projects.description: Real-time fraud pattern detection pipeline built on Databricks, fed with live transactional data from SAP. Processed and analyzed data streams to identify anomalous patterns, triggering automated email alerts in real time for immediate response by the finance and operations teams.
